controls.name: descending-cost-queue
controls.why: Reverses actual cost ordering; minimum must still be least cost.

controls.name: node-only-seen-dominance
controls.why: Rejects a newly reached smaller-hop label just because the node was seen.

controls.name: exact-cap-neighbor-rejected
controls.why: Makes the actual inclusive maxCost admission exclusive.

controls.name: parent-does-not-point-to-accepted-predecessor
controls.why: Stores child state as its own predecessor.

controls.name: nonpositive-weight-zero
controls.why: Changes default/nonpositive effective weight from one to zero.

controls.name: exact-cap-target-not-returned
controls.why: Tests target only below maxCost, losing exact-cap accepted paths.

controls.name: backtrack-stops-on-hopzero
controls.why: Unbounded search uses hop zero at every node, so hop zero is not the root test.

controls.name: popped-entry-not-recorded
controls.why: Loses the derived finite-pop history needed for the strict Continue rank.
